speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked	the Minister for Finance whether the Ministry will consider requiring environmental audits according to international best practices to be done on firms in which GIC and Temasek Holdings have a financial interest and which firms can potentially be contributing to the haze problem.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: The Minister has previously responded to the Member on the same topic.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: The investment activities of GIC and Temasek Holdings are oriented towards generating long-term returns on a sustainable basis.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: Some of these companies are working towards certifications that require adherence to zero-burn practices.
